title: Claude Code Dynamic Workflows: Claude writes orchestration scripts on the fly, spins up parallel agents
why_it_matters: The engineering lead's thread explaining how dynamic workflows actually work under the hood — Claude generates a deterministic orchestration script then executes it across parallel agents. Essential context for anyone building on Claude Code.

title: Surya OCR 2: 650M params, top score under 3B on OlmOCR bench, 91 languages
why_it_matters: Surya OCR 2 hits 83.3% on OlmOCR benchmark — the top score for any model under 3B parameters — while supporting 91 languages. Practical OCR that runs on modest hardware just got dramatically better.

title: Opus 4.8: Strongest coding model with excellent judgment and warm, honest vibe

action: Switch to Opus 4.8 in Claude Code

title: Claude Code now lets you configure effort level and adaptive thinking directly
why_it_matters: You can now set effort level directly in Claude Code via /effort and in Cowork — giving you granular control over how much thinking the model does per task. This is the practical lever for balancing speed vs. depth in daily work.

why_it_matters: Auto mode expanding to Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry for Opus 4.7/4.8 means enterprise teams on non-direct API can now use Claude Code's most autonomous execution mode. This unblocks a large segment of enterprise users who were locked out of auto mode.

title: AI Safety Institute open-sources its evaluation datasets and evals
why_it_matters: The UK AI Safety Institute releasing its evals and datasets publicly is a major win for transparent AI safety — now anyone can reproduce and build on the government's safety testing methodology.

why_it_matters: A from-scratch LLM inference engine in C++ and CUDA aiming for vLLM-level performance with a smaller, more hackable codebase. Worth watching if you need inference infrastructure you can actually read and modify.
